payload.statement: The current returns_policy_v2 explicitly sets the standard-item full-refund window at 30 days, matching the claimed 30-day window.
payload.plan: Extracted numeric return windows from policy_docs and base_retrieval, compared the claimed 30-day window to the current v2 policy and the stale v1/judge reference, and checked order age 10 days against both windows; a two-sample t-test was not applicable because no n/mean/sd fields were provided.

evidence.inferential_test: not applicable; no two-group n/mean/sd data, so deterministic numeric consistency check was used
